comment: Session-title generation asks for a 64-token completion with thinking off; answer with a short canned title so the acceptance run does not depend on the prompt echo.
Compaction requests are marked by the harness header; keep them short.

Default rule: mirror the last user message. The LLM-run acceptance sends '请只回复：<mark>' and asserts the turn reached the transcript, so echoing the mark is the strongest possible evidence that the request really passed through this mock.
